6790.title: Pi extension descriptor compatibility
6790.rootCauseOneLine: The Node extension synchronously wraps fd 4 with net.Socket; an unrecognized descriptor aborts extension loading before its error listener exists. The identical error was reproduced with a deliberately closed Linux descriptor, not a Windows inherited pipe.
6790.proposedFix: First reproduce the real launcher and extension on isolated Windows, identify missing versus unwrappable handles, then choose a portable transport with bidirectional tool-result and shutdown regression coverage.
6790.caveats: Repeated by the same agent in two clean trusted checkouts. Linux Node 22.19.0 and pinned Pi library 0.84.0 only; no Windows or Pi 1.4.0 end-to-end reproduction. No safe simple fix or pull request.
